label: Total War: Three Kingdoms sandboxes
description: How Total War: Three Kingdoms sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: A pack is only loaded when it is enabled in the game's launcher (the user script). This app puts the file there; enabling it is the launcher's job.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.

presets.label: Modded
presets.description: Mods deployed into the game folder.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed: the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
